verses.text: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
lines: My heart overflows with a noble theme.
I recite my verses for the king.
My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

verses.text: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
lines: You are the most excellent of the sons of men.
Grace has anointed your lips,
therefore God has blessed you forever.

verses.text: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
lines: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one:
your splendor and your majesty.

verses.text: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
lines: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.
Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

verses.text: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
lines: Your arrows are sharp.
The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.text: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
lines: Your throne, God, is forever and ever.
A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

verses.text: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
lines: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness.
Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

verses.text: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
lines: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia.
Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

verses.text: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
lines: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women.
At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

verses.text: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
lines: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear.
Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

verses.text: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
lines: So the king will desire your beauty,
honor him, for he is your lord.

verses.text: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
lines: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift.
The rich among the people entreat your favor.

verses.text: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
lines: The princess inside is all glorious.
Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

verses.text: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
lines: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work.
The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

verses.text: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
lines: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led.
They shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.text: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
lines: Your sons will take the place of your fathers.
You shall make them princes in all the earth.

verses.text: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
lines: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
